QuestInfo.name: Information Dealer's Request 1
QuestInfo.0: #bTru#k in #bLith Harbor#k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Tru frequently faces danger in his line of work, and would like a weapon to defend himself with. He asks you for an Axe Pole Arm. He prefers one made by a famous blacksmith...\n\n#i1442003##t1442003#  #b#c1442003# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave Tru an Axe Pole Arm. But can he really use a weapon this size...?

0.0: Did you need some information? Or...are you here to do me a favor?

yes.0: My request is simple. I need a weapon. Don't worry, I don't need anything fancy. I just need to be able to defend myself.
yes.1: The life of an information dealer is dangerous... In fact, I'm constantly getting attacked by this monster or that disgruntled client. I was hoping to learn how to at least protect myself.
yes.2: I'm thinking of getting an #bAxe Pole Arm#k. It doesn't have to be especially good, but I'd like something better than what you can get in the shops. Something made just for me! Of course, if you're not a Blacksmith, you could always buy it from one.

1.0: Oh, is that my new Axe Pole Arm? Let me see it! HI-YAH!

yes.0: ACK! This...this is heavier than it looks! The person I saw using this earlier twirled it around with such ease... Ugh. I can't swing this thing! Well, thanks anyway.

item.0: Were you able to find an #bAxe Pole Arm#k yet? If you really can't find one, you can just buy it from a merchant.
